answer: Because the timing is recorded against the pearl challenge, the horizon audit can replay the karst history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 297 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3791 identities would post 4792 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
